tokens.name: notch
tokens.usage: The notch and everything it shows: every card, the transcript window, Settings, the welcome tour. Pure black, always; never a dark grey.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, answers and primary text on notch (21:1).

tokens.name: ink-code
tokens.usage: Commands and code on notch and on fill-quiet (about 13:1).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: The small line around a big one: the verb over a subject ("Opened"), the detail under a headline, labels. On notch only (about 6:1).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Paths, hints and timestamps on notch (about 4.6:1). Not on fill-quiet.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and resting glyphs only (about 3:1 on notch): never for text someone has to read.

tokens.name: fill-quiet
tokens.usage: Resting pills, rows, code wells and icon circles on notch.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: The same things under the pointer, and the off state of a toggle pill.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: The one main action in a card (Done, Allow, Move to Trash) and a toggle pill that's on. Text on it is on-fill-strong.

tokens.name: on-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on fill-strong (about 19:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Window edges and dividers between rows, 1px. The notch itself has no border.

tokens.name: surface-row
tokens.usage: Grouped settings rows in the Settings window, on notch. Never inside the notch.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The check circle, and nothing else: a white check on a green disc after something worked. Always the shape too, never color alone. White on it is about 2.3:1, kept from the app; the check's shape carries the meaning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The cross circle (failed, cancelled) and the word Overdue. White on it is about 3.5:1.

tokens.name: desktop-top
tokens.usage: Only behind the notch in previews and product shots: the top of the desktop.

tokens.name: desktop-bottom
tokens.usage: Only behind the notch in previews and product shots: the bottom of the desktop.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The answer itself, when it's a fact: one or two lines, ink.

styles.name: outcome
styles.usage: Beside a check or a cross: what happened, in a few words.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: Under a headline, at most two lines, ink-secondary.

styles.name: verb
styles.usage: Over an item's name: what was done to it, ink-secondary.

styles.name: answer
styles.sample: Dana wants the pricing page live before launch, at $12 a seat.
styles.usage: An answer that's a sentence or three, ink. Longer moves to the long card.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The time in the open notch, tabular figures.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Live text, status lines and the camera row (time, Live, Copied).

styles.name: done-title
styles.usage: The end of a meeting: one friendly line, big.

styles.name: command
styles.usage: Real shell commands only, in an approval card or a code answer, ink-code on fill-quiet.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The welcome tour's step titles, ending with a period.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Starlight only asks for what a feature needs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between pills in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a glyph and its words; the gap under the notch's camera row.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Between an item's icon and its name; card bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Tile and window padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: The text inset inside every notch card: words never come closer to the curved edges.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: The welcome tour's side margins.

tokens.name: radius-notch-closed
tokens.usage: The notch's bottom corners at rest, about the hardware notch's own.

tokens.name: radius-notch-open
tokens.usage: The bottom corners once grown 110pt taller; they ease between the two with the notch's size.

tokens.name: radius-flare
tokens.usage: The concave curve where the notch meets the top of the screen, open.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Task rows, code wells, pictures beside an answer.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Grouped settings rows.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Permission tiles and the welcome tour's boxes.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: The transcript window.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and toggle: capsules only.

tokens.name: notch-shadow
tokens.usage: Under the notch while it's hovered, open or showing something. Off at rest.

tokens.name: window-shadow
tokens.usage: Under floating windows (transcript, tasks).

tokens.name: answer-width
tokens.usage: An answer card's width.

tokens.name: long-answer-width
tokens.usage: Code and long answers: wider, scrolling inside, up to 420px tall.

tokens.name: picture
tokens.usage: The picture beside a named place or person.

tokens.name: item-icon
tokens.usage: An app's or file's icon in an item card.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: The check or cross circle.
